method: Three-start bounded discrete coordinate descent; not a differentiable gradient or a global optimum.
screen: 5 mm mesh; 3 quadrature points per band through 3150 Hz; higher bands conservatively unchanged.
constraints: 100 mm beam-centre placement increments; first centre fixed at (150,200) mm as reference; stock sizes multiples of 5 mm; angles searched in 5 degree steps; first layer >=75% and combined >=50% geometrical frontal opening.
